parameters.query: SELECT result, video_id::text AS video_id, version, round FROM telegram_decide($1, $2::bigint, $3, $4);
SELECT result, token, expires_at, brief, has_voice, error FROM telegram_intake_draft($1::bigint, $2, $3::jsonb);
SELECT result, detail, rules FROM telegram_rules($1::bigint, $2, $3, $4, $5);
